sources.query: SELECT INTEGRATION_ID, BANK_ACCT_NUM, BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME, BANK_ALT_NAME, BANK_NAME, BANK_BRANCH_NAME, BANK_BRANCH_CODE, BANK_NUMBER, BANK_CAT_CODE, BANK_TYPE_CODE, BANK_USER_NAME, CONTACT_NAME, PHONE_NUM, CHANGED_BY_ID, CREATED_BY_ID, CHANGED_ON_DT, CREATED_ON_DT, SRC_EFF_FROM_DT, ACTIVE_FLG, STREET_ADDRESS1, COUNTY, STATE_NAME, CITY, COUNTRY_CODE, AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE, PRIMARY_FLAG, END_DATE, TENANT_ID, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID FROM W_BANK_DS

WITH internal_accounts AS (SELECT ACC.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID AS BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, ACC.BANK_BRANCH_ID AS BANK_BRANCH_ID, ACC.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM AS BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER, ACC.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME AS BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME, ACC.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME_ALT AS BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME_ALT, ACC.BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE AS BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE, ACC.ACCOUNT_HOLDER_NAME AS ACCOUNT_HOLDER_NAME, ACC.AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE AS AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE, 'Y' AS PRIMARY_FLAG, ACC.END_DATE AS END_DATE, ACC.CREATION_DATE AS CREATION_DATE, ACC.CREATED_BY AS CREATED_BY, ACC.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE, ACC.LAST_UPDATED_BY AS LAST_UPDATED_BY, 'INTERNAL' AS SRC_ACCOUNT_TYPE FROM CE_BANK_ACCOUNTS ACC), external_accounts AS (SELECT EB.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID AS BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, EB.BRANCH_ID AS BANK_BRANCH_ID, EB.MASKED_BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM AS BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER, EB.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME AS BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME, EB.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME_ALT AS BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME_ALT, EB.BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE AS BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(240)) AS ACCOUNT_HOLDER_NAME, EB.AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE AS AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE, OW.PRIMARY_FLAG AS PRIMARY_FLAG, OW.END_DATE AS END_DATE, EB.CREATION_DATE AS CREATION_DATE, EB.CREATED_BY AS CREATED_BY, EB.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE, EB.LAST_UPDATED_BY AS LAST_UPDATED_BY, 'EXTERNAL' AS SRC_ACCOUNT_TYPE FROM IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS EB LEFT JOIN IBY_ACCOUNT_OWNERS OW ON OW.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = EB.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID AND OW.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'), all_accounts AS (SELECT * FROM internal_accounts UNION ALL SELECT * FROM external_accounts), branches AS (SELECT branchparty.party_id AS bank_branch_id, bankorgprofile.organization_name AS bank_name, bankorgprofile.bank_or_branch_number AS bank_number, branchparty.party_name AS bank_branch_name, branchparty.address1 AS address_line1, branchparty.city AS city, branchparty.province AS county, branchparty.state AS state, branchparty.country AS country, bankca.class_code AS institution_type FROM hz_organization_profiles bankorgprofile JOIN hz_relationships brrel ON brrel.object_id = bankorgprofile.party_id AND brrel.relationship_type = 'BANK_AND_BRANCH' AND brrel.relationship_code = 'BRANCH_OF' AND brrel.status = 'A' JOIN hz_parties branchparty ON branchparty.party_id = brrel.subject_id AND branchparty.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND branchparty.status = 'A' JOIN hz_code_assignments bankca ON bankca.owner_table_id = bankorgprofile.party_id AND bankca.owner_table_name = 'HZ_PARTIES' AND bankca.class_category = 'BANK_INSTITUTION_TYPE' AND bankca.class_code IN ('BANK','CLEARINGHOUSE') AND NVL(bankca.status,'A') = 'A'), enriched AS (SELECT A.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, A.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER, A.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME, A.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME_ALT, A.BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE, A.ACCOUNT_HOLDER_NAME, A.AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE, A.PRIMARY_FLAG, A.END_DATE, A.CREATION_DATE, A.CREATED_BY, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, A.SRC_ACCOUNT_TYPE, B.bank_name, B.bank_number, B.bank_branch_name, B.address_line1, B.city, B.county, B.state, B.country, B.institution_type, HP.PARTY_NAME AS contact_name, PR.PRIMARY_PHONE_AREA_CODE || '-' || PR.PRIMARY_PHONE_NUMBER AS phone_num, (CASE WHEN A.SRC_ACCOUNT_TYPE = 'EXTERNAL' THEN 'E' ELSE 'I' END || '~' || TO_CHAR(A.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID)) AS INTEGRATION_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY (CASE WHEN A.SRC_ACCOUNT_TYPE = 'EXTERNAL' THEN 'E' ELSE 'I' END || '~' || TO_CHAR(A.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID)) ORDER BY A.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID) AS RN FROM all_accounts A JOIN branches B ON B.bank_branch_id = A.BANK_BRANCH_ID LEFT JOIN CE_CONTACT_ASSIGNMENTS CCA ON CCA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = A.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID LEFT JOIN HZ_RELATIONSHIPS HR ON HR.RELATIONSHIP_ID = CCA.RELATIONSHIP_ID AND HR.RELATIONSHIP_CODE = 'CONTACT_OF' LEFT JOIN HZ_PARTIES HP ON HP.PARTY_ID = HR.SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN HZ_PARTIES PR ON PR.PARTY_ID = HR.PARTY_ID) SELECT INTEGRATION_ID, BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER AS BANK_ACCT_NUM, BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME AS BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME, BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME_ALT AS BANK_ALT_NAME, bank_name AS BANK_NAME, bank_branch_name AS BANK_BRANCH_NAME, bank_branch_name AS BANK_BRANCH_CODE, bank_number AS BANK_NUMBER, BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE AS BANK_CAT_CODE, institution_type AS BANK_TYPE_CODE, ACCOUNT_HOLDER_NAME AS BANK_USER_NAME, contact_name AS CONTACT_NAME, phone_num AS PHONE_NUM, TO_CHAR(LAST_UPDATED_BY) AS CHANGED_BY_ID, TO_CHAR(CREATED_BY) AS CREATED_BY_ID, LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS CHANGED_ON_DT, CREATION_DATE AS CREATED_ON_DT, TO_DATE('18990101000000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS SRC_EFF_FROM_DT, 'Y' AS ACTIVE_FLG, address_line1 AS STREET_ADDRESS1, COALESCE(county, state) AS COUNTY, state AS STATE_NAME, city AS CITY, country AS COUNTRY_CODE, AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE, PRIMARY_FLAG, END_DATE FROM enriched WHERE RN = 1
